Hi Anika,

Great to meet on the call yesterday — excited about the workshop next month. I put together a couple of timing options below that should work for our exec + engineering runs: 

- Option A: Tue Aug 15 — full day (09:00–17:00 PT) with customer exec briefing at 09:00
- Option B: Wed Aug 16 — half-day (13:00–17:00 PT) focusing on integration and Q&A
- Option C: Thu Aug 17 — split sessions (09:00–12:00 PT / 14:00–16:00 PT) for separate product and infra tracks

Can you confirm: preferred option, estimated headcount (onsite vs virtual), and whether you want a 30-minute technical test run (recommended) 48–72 hours beforehand? We can run the tech test over the same Zoom link and test AV/connectivity and SSO flows.

Attached is a first-pass agenda (redwood_proposed_agenda_v0.pdf). Monica is on copy and will coordinate logistics and travel. If any of these dates clash with your internal calendar, send a few alternate dates and we’ll adjust.

Next steps after you confirm the slot: I’ll share calendar holds for Redwood & Zenith attendees, a short runbook for the on-site room AV, and a checklist for the tech test.

Thanks,
